scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run test:contract
scripts.test:unit: node --test --experimental-test-module-mocks tests/unit/agent.test.mjs tests/unit/runtime.test.mjs tests/unit/relay.test.mjs tests/unit/chain.test.mjs tests/unit/inbox.test.mjs
scripts.build:verify: esbuild scripts/verify-page.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --define:import.meta.main=false --legal-comments=none --outfile=web/verify.mjs "--banner:js=import { createRequire as __cr } from 'node:module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);"
scripts.web:files: node -e "for (const d of ['config', 'evidence']) require('fs').cpSync(d, 'web/' + d, { recursive: true })"
